findings.title: Quick presets showed the URL filename (all) instead of the playlist name
Guide API exceeded SQLite bound variables for 1,000+ matched channels
Android WebView loaded the static redirect document instead of the app shell
Remote/touch input did not wake the lower-third guide control after idle
Sources, Settings and Watch body copy are not localized; RTL sweep incomplete
SUS and task success need 5-8 first-time participants
Guide phase shows an error state while it is still progressing
Full sync on a 1,495-channel library exceeded 11 minutes
Reloading mid-sync loses console history and last-run status
